verdict_reason: Unescaped reference numbers in govukTable html can XSS the dashboard, and a countries-client failure also takes the whole page down.

todos.issue: buildTableRows interpolates notification.referenceNumber into govukTable html without escaping, so a reference containing markup can XSS the dashboard (the address-book list uses escapeHtml for the same visually-hidden text).
todos.fix: HTML-escape referenceNumber (and treat href as an attribute) before interpolating into the View link html, matching address-book/list/controller.js.

todos.issue: getCountries is on the same try path as listNotifications, so a reference-data failure 500s the dashboard even though originCountry already falls back to the raw code.
todos.fix: Fetch countries separately (warn and use {} on failure) so listNotifications can still render the rows required by AC1.
